issue_target.label: SUPPORTED
issue_target.exact_quote:
The conclusions reached cannot be said to be based on no evidence. All relevant material has been taken into consideration.
We have been constrained to make elaborate reference to the orders of ARC and ARCT only to demonstrate that High Court was not justified in observing that there has been `serious dereliction of duty' or that there has been `blatant violation of the fundamental principles of law and justice' by the ARC and ARCT.
We, therefore, allow this appeal and set aside the impugned judgment and order.
issue_target.reason: At the issue level, the landlord's section 14(1)(b) eviction result is supported through the target court's holding that Article 227 intervention was unjustified and its setting aside of the High Court judgment, thereby leaving the ARC/ARCT result operative.
issue_target.procedural_limit: SUPPORTED is procedural/derivative, not a de novo Supreme Court merits determination of C1-C6. The target court expressly states that its elaborate references to ARC/ARCT were to assess the propriety of High Court supervisory intervention.
